"Thanks, Ashlin," says Kristen. "I think I like baths!"

textContent.text: Kevin the Rabbit hopped into class. He looked at the clock. "The big math test is at seven. Then we will have snack," he said to his pal Hops.
Hops shrugged and said, "We can do this, Kevin."
Kevin nodded, but his chest still thumped. He sat still.
Mr. Gavin told the rabbits to get out their laptops. Kevin grabbed his from his backpack and put it on his desk.
Just then, Hops tapped Kevin. He passed Kevin a napkin. "Read it," said Hops.
Kevin looked down. On the napkin it said, "Good luck! You can do it!"
Kevin looked up and grinned. He grabbed his pencil. He flipped the napkin to the back and put, "You are my best pal!"

textContent.text: "Max, let's go! The picnic basket is packed," Kim said, putting on her jacket.
The basket was filled with snacks and a big ham sandwich. Max smelled the snacks and licked his lips.
"I will get the blanket!" he said, grabbing one from the closet.
Then, Max and Kim walked up the tall hill. They set the blanket in the hot sun. Max sat and fanned his neck.
SWISH!
"What was that?" Max said, looking at a bush.
Just then, a rabbit popped out! It hopped to the blanket and looked at the kids.
"Want some of my sandwich?" Max asked. The rabbit smelled it, but did not eat it.
Kim held up a pumpkin muffin. The rabbit hopped over to her and bit it!
Kim grinned and said, "This rabbit wanted a snack!"
Kim and Max watched the rabbit hop back to the grass and down the hill.
"Thanks for the visit," Max said.

textContent.text: On a hot day in spring, three chickens sit in a shed.
"It's too hot. I don't want to play," Pippin says. "I just want to rest."
But Velvet and Brock want to jump and sing. Brock grabs a bucket and lid. Velvet digs in a red bin and finds a trumpet.
"Now we are a band!" Velvet says.
Pippin sits up. "That looks like a blast! Can I be in it?" she asks.
Velvet grins. "You can hum the song!" she says.
Brock bangs the lid on the bucket. Velvet plays the trumpet. Pippin hums.
When they finish, Brock hops up. "What will we call our band?" she clucks.
Velvet jumps up. "Let's be Chicken Jams!"
